question: Break the October SQD transfers on Arbitrum and Base into exchanges and the wallets that dealt with them, contracts and the wallets that dealt with them, bridges (which wallet sent SQD to wallets on a different chain), and P2P transfers between EOAs, bridges included

definitions.SQD: The SQD token at 0x1337420ded5adb9980cfc35f8f2b054ea86f8ab1 on Arbitrum and 0xd4554bea546efa83c1e6b389ecac40ea999b3e78 on Base, as in answers/sqd-net-accumulators
definitions.exchange: An address in Dune's cex.addresses labels for its chain (transformation/seeds), or an address that sent all its SQD in the window to one such exchange address (a deposit address)
definitions.contract: An address with code at the latest block when the code was read, other than an exchange or an EIP-7702 delegated EOA
definitions.EOA: An address with no code, or with an EIP-7702 delegation, that is not an exchange
definitions.bridge: A mint or burn of SQD by the chain's canonical bridge to Ethereum. An Arbitrum withdrawal and a Base deposit (or the reverse) pair up when the Ethereum address and the amount match, the deposit coming after the withdrawal
definitions.P2P: A transfer between two EOAs on one chain, plus a paired bridge flow whose two ends are EOAs
definitions.pairing: Within one Ethereum address, token and amount, the nth withdrawal pairs with the nth deposit into the other L2, in time order, when the deposit comes at least 6.4 days (from Arbitrum) or 1 day (from Base) after it (models/marts/bridges/bridge_pairs.sql)
definitions.transfer to self: A transfer from an address to itself is left out
definitions.category of a transfer: The first that fits: bridge (a mint or burn), exchange (either side is an exchange), contract (either side is a contract), P2P (both sides are EOAs)

alternatives: Read code at the window's last block instead of now, so an address that became a contract after October counts as an EOA
Leave inferred deposit addresses out of the exchange category
Count EIP-7702 delegated EOAs as contracts
Pair bridge flows by loading Ethereum's side of each bridge instead of matching Ethereum address and amount

-- The share of the SQD moved on Arbitrum and Base in October 2026 that went to or came from an exchange
-- or one of its deposit addresses, in percent. sqd_categories_by_category has every category.
with classified as (
    
with transfers as (
    select chain, id, block_number, block_timestamp, tx_hash, from_address, to_address, value
    from "warehouse"."analytics_sqd"."erc20_transfers"
    where chain = 'arbitrum'
        and token = '0x1337420ded5adb9980cfc35f8f2b054ea86f8ab1'
        and block_number between 510496864 and 520129273
        and from_address <> to_address
    union all
    select chain, id, block_number, block_timestamp, tx_hash, from_address, to_address, value
    from "warehouse"."analytics_sqd"."erc20_transfers"
    where chain = 'base'
        and token = '0xd4554bea546efa83c1e6b389ecac40ea999b3e78'
        and block_number between 52011727 and 53350926
        and from_address <> to_address
),

labels as (
    select chain, address, kind, exchange from "warehouse"."analytics_sqd"."address_labels"
),

-- Addresses whose every transfer out in the window went to one exchange's labelled addresses.
deposits as (
    select t.chain, t.from_address as address, min(l.exchange) as exchange
    from transfers as t
    left join labels as l on l.chain = t.chain and l.address = t.to_address and l.kind = 'exchange'
    left join labels as self on self.chain = t.chain and self.address = t.from_address
    where t.from_address <> '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000'
        and coalesce(self.kind, '') <> 'exchange'
    group by t.chain, t.from_address
    having bool_and(l.exchange is not null) and count(distinct l.exchange) = 1
),

sides as (
    select
        t.*,
        case
            when t.from_address = '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' then 'bridge'
            when fd.address is not null then 'deposit'
            else coalesce(fl.kind, 'unknown')
        end as from_kind,
        coalesce(fl.exchange, fd.exchange) as from_exchange,
        case
            when t.to_address = '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' then 'bridge'
            when td.address is not null then 'deposit'
            else coalesce(tl.kind, 'unknown')
        end as to_kind,
        coalesce(tl.exchange, td.exchange) as to_exchange
    from transfers as t
    left join labels as fl on fl.chain = t.chain and fl.address = t.from_address
    left join labels as tl on tl.chain = t.chain and tl.address = t.to_address
    left join deposits as fd on fd.chain = t.chain and fd.address = t.from_address
    left join deposits as td on td.chain = t.chain and td.address = t.to_address
)

select
    *,
    case
        when 'bridge' in (from_kind, to_kind) then 'bridge'
        when from_kind in ('exchange', 'deposit') or to_kind in ('exchange', 'deposit') then 'exchange'
        when 'contract' in (from_kind, to_kind) then 'contract'
        when from_kind = 'eoa' and to_kind = 'eoa' then 'p2p'
        else 'unknown'
    end as category
from sides
)

select round(100 * sum(value) filter (where category = 'exchange') / sum(value), 2) as exchange_share_pct
from classified

-- Every SQD move between Arbitrum or Base and Ethereum in October 2026 through each chain's own bridge,
-- oldest first: the L2 address and its kind, the Ethereum address on the other side, and, when the move
-- pairs with one into or out of the other L2 through Ethereum (bridge_pairs), that move's chain, L2
-- address and time. SQD has one Ethereum token, 0x1337420ded5adb9980cfc35f8f2b054ea86f8ab1.
with moves as (
    select b.*, l.kind as l2_kind
    from "warehouse"."analytics_sqd"."bridge_transfers" as b
    left join "warehouse"."analytics_sqd"."address_labels" as l on l.chain = b.chain and l.address = b.l2_address
    where b.ethereum_token = '0x1337420ded5adb9980cfc35f8f2b054ea86f8ab1'
        and (
            (b.chain = 'arbitrum' and b.block_number between 510496864 and 520129273)
            or (b.chain = 'base' and b.block_number between 52011727 and 53350926)
        )
),

pairs as (
    select * from "warehouse"."analytics_sqd"."bridge_pairs"
    where ethereum_token = '0x1337420ded5adb9980cfc35f8f2b054ea86f8ab1'
)

select
    m.chain,
    m.direction,
    m.l2_address,
    m.l2_kind,
    m.ethereum_address,
    round(m.amount / 1e18, 6) as sqd,
    m.block_timestamp,
    m.tx_hash,
    coalesce(sent.to_chain, received.from_chain) as other_chain,
    coalesce(sent.to_address, received.from_address) as other_l2_address,
    coalesce(sent.deposited_at, received.withdrawn_at) as other_at
from moves as m
left join pairs as sent on sent.withdrawal_id = m.id and sent.from_chain = m.chain
left join pairs as received on received.deposit_id = m.id and received.to_chain = m.chain
order by m.block_timestamp, m.chain, m.id

    join "warehouse"."analytics_sqd"."address_labels" as f on f.chain = p.from_chain and f.address = p.from_address and f.kind = 'eoa'
